name: free_conv_cylinders
title: Free convection from cylinders: Nusselt-number correlations for vertical and horizontal cylinders (function library)
summary: Thirteen EES FUNCTIONs returning the Nusselt number of natural convection from a cylinder: ten for a vertical isothermal cylinder (Griffiths-Davis-Morgan, Jakob-Linke-Morgan, Carne-Morgan, Eigenson-Morgan with its three branches, Touloukian-Morgan, McAdams-Weiss-Saunders, Kreith-Eckert, Hanesian-Kalish-Morgan, Al-Arabi-Khamis and Popiel-Churchill, the last two taking the height L and the diameter D) and three for a horizontal one (Churchill-Chu, Kuehn-Goldstein, Morgan with its five Rayleigh-number ranges). Eight vertical-cylinder correlations take a three-state regime flag (automatic, laminar, turbulent). Pr and Gr are arguments, so the calling model passes them; the heat-transfer coefficient follows from h = Nu*k/D and is left to the caller.
